name: Righteous Smash

name: Zealous Cleave

name: Conviction

assumptions: The sheet said stack_rule=replace, which never stacks past 1; refresh keeps up to 5. Bonus per stack is open for the stacks ticket. Shows under Heroic Strike (78).
